packs.name: PLM Foundation
packs.behavior: Teams manage product data in spreadsheets, shared drives, and email. No single source of truth.
packs.painpoints: Version conflicts, lost files, manual data entry, no audit trail.
packs.hopes: Centralized product data, version control, faster collaboration, audit readiness.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Foundation provides a secure, cloud-native PLM foundation that eliminates data silos and enables real-time collaboration at an affordable price.
macroProcessText: MP-27: Data Governance & Master Data Management

packs.name: Product Engineering
packs.behavior: Engineers work in CAD silos; requirements are managed in documents; BOMs are manually created.
packs.painpoints: Design errors, BOM inaccuracies, slow design reviews, lack of traceability.
packs.hopes: Integrated CAD-PLM, automated BOM generation, real-time design collaboration, requirements traceability.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Product Engineering connects CAD, requirements, and BOM management into a unified engineering environment, reducing design errors and accelerating time-to-market.
macroProcessText: MP-57: Generative AI & Autonomous Design Management

packs.name: Manufacturing Operations
packs.behavior: Work instructions are paper-based; production data is siloed in MES; cost data is disconnected from engineering.
packs.painpoints: Operator errors, production delays, inaccurate cost estimates, slow change propagation.
packs.hopes: Digital work instructions, real-time production visibility, accurate costing, faster change adoption.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Manufacturing Operations bridges engineering and production with digital work instructions, real-time cost roll-up, and mobile access for shop-floor operators.

packs.name: Quality & Compliance
packs.behavior: Quality data is fragmented across PLM, QMS, and ERP; audits are stressful; compliance is reactive.
packs.painpoints: Audit findings, submission delays, compliance risks, recurring defects.
packs.hopes: Audit readiness, closed-loop quality, automated compliance, faster approvals.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Quality & Compliance provides a unified quality and compliance framework with CAPA, FMEA, NCR, and regulatory submission management.

packs.name: Service Lifecycle
packs.behavior: Service teams lack access to product data; SLAs are managed manually; field service is reactive.
packs.painpoints: Slow service resolution, wrong parts sent to field, low first-time fix rates, customer dissatisfaction.
packs.hopes: Real-time service data, predictive maintenance, optimized scheduling, improved CSAT.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Service Lifecycle provides end-to-end service management from catalog to delivery, with IoT-driven predictive maintenance and field service mobility.
macroProcessText: MP-23: Incident, Problem, Request & Change Management

packs.name: Innovation & Portfolio
packs.behavior: Innovation projects lack structure; portfolios are managed in spreadsheets; gate reviews are informal.
packs.painpoints: Project overruns, unclear priorities, missed market windows, resource misallocation.
packs.hopes: Structured phase-gate governance, portfolio visibility, faster time-to-market, strategic alignment.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Innovation & Portfolio provides configurable innovation tracks (Full/Light/Fast), phase-gate governance, and gate checklist management for disciplined innovation.

packs.name: AI & Digital Twin
packs.behavior: Product performance data is siloed in IoT platforms; AI is not embedded in PLM; reliability is reactive.
packs.painpoints: No feedback loop from field to design, unplanned downtime, recurring failures.
packs.hopes: Real-time digital twin, predictive maintenance, AI-driven insights, faster design improvements.
packs.fit: CortexPLM AI & Digital Twin embeds AI/ML across all processes and connects IoT data to the digital thread for predictive maintenance and continuous improvement.
macroProcessText: MP-15: AI & Machine Learning Core Services

packs.name: Sustainability & Circular Economy
packs.behavior: Sustainability data is collected manually; circular economy is aspirational; compliance is reactive.
packs.painpoints: Regulatory penalties, missed ESG targets, reputation risks.
packs.hopes: Automated sustainability reporting, circular economy certifications, digital product passports.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Sustainability provides end-to-end ESG management, from material compliance to circular economy certifications and digital product passports.

packs.name: Regulated Industries
packs.behavior: Industry-specific compliance is managed in silos; audits are manual; submissions are slow.
packs.painpoints: Compliance gaps, submission delays, audit findings, product recalls.
packs.hopes: Industry-specific compliance, automated submissions, audit readiness, recall prevention.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Regulated Industries provides pre-built compliance frameworks for MedTech, Pharma, Aerospace, and Automotive.
macroProcessText: MP-96: Medical Device UDI & Post-Market Surveillance Management

packs.name: Product-Service Systems
packs.behavior: Product and service lifecycles are managed separately; installed base is untracked; contracts are complex.
packs.painpoints: Revenue leakage, poor customer experience, unoptimized service inventory.
packs.hopes: Integrated product-service lifecycle, installed base visibility, outcome-based contracts.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Product-Service Systems unifies product and service lifecycles with outcome-based contract management, installed base tracking, and field service mobility.
macroProcessText: MP-161 to MP-170: Pure Service Industry (all)

packs.name: CortexPLM Enterprise
packs.behavior: Multiple PLM, ERP, and MES systems across sites; data is fragmented; governance is complex.
packs.painpoints: Data inconsistencies, high TCO, slow decision-making, compliance risks.
packs.hopes: Single source of truth, end-to-end digital thread, enterprise-wide governance, AI-driven insights.
packs.fit: CortexPLM Enterprise provides all 69 macro processes, all integrations, and all add-ons in a single, unified platform.

reviewNotes.observation: Six bundles state savings that do not match the pack prices (BND-03 to BND-08).
reviewNotes.action: Correct either the bundle price or the stated percentage.

reviewNotes.observation: BND-08 Complete Bundle costs USD 799, while PACK-11 CortexPLM Enterprise (USD 299) already includes all modules, integrations and add-ons, and BND-08 itself contains PACK-11.
reviewNotes.action: Remove BND-08, or redefine it (e.g., PACK-11 plus premium services) so the offer is coherent.

reviewNotes.observation: Section 1.1 states "USD 40/month per pack"; Section 5.1 states "USD 40/user/month".
reviewNotes.action: This edition uses "per user per month" throughout; confirm.

reviewNotes.observation: Add-ons have no price in the catalog.
reviewNotes.action: Add a price list for add-ons (flat, per user or per unit).

reviewNotes.observation: INT-COL-03 PLM-ALM (Collaboration) overlaps with the ALM category (INT-ALM-01 to 03).
reviewNotes.action: Merge it into 3.9 ALM Integrations or rename it to show the difference.

reviewNotes.observation: PACK-08 and PACK-10 have only one compatible integration each.
reviewNotes.action: Consider mapping relevant connectors (e.g., INT-SRM-02 to PACK-10, INT-IOT-02 to PACK-10, INT-DAT-01 to PACK-08).

reviewNotes.observation: The source title claimed "The #1 PSLM Application".
reviewNotes.action: Omitted from the cover under the Mounire Benhima voice guidelines; restore if supported by independent evidence.

principles: Customers buy only what they need.
Start small, expand as needs grow.
Each pack targets a specific customer profile.
Packs include pre-built connectors to relevant external systems.
Pricing reflects the value delivered, not just features.
